name: Badge
description: Subject: antd@5.29.3 (pinned, examples/antd/PROVENANCE.md). CURATED seed for the antd P2 exam (code→canvas, held out) — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Every axis value is the library's own declared enum (antd spells them as `readonly [...]` tuples; seed-gen reads them once its declaration lookup ignores directory case — W1, examples/antd/RECON.md §4). MOLECULE WRAPPER (the MUI Badge precedent): the Avatar child is mounted by the config's childrenSpec. `mode` is a synthetic 2-value axis (count|dot) that the config expands through $props into antd's two APIs (`count: 5` vs `dot: true`) — ONE axis so the per-value overlay parts stay a one-axis function. `color` is DEFAULTLESS (unset = antd's red count badge); the 3 presets are a curated slice. NAMED OUT: status mode (a different root composition), overflowCount/showZero, counts other than 5.
